title: STACKWISE Empirical Evidence Benchmark v1.0.0
description: A harmonised, provenance-preserving multi-source benchmark derived from four independently published real IoT measurement datasets. The benchmark separates source-specific analysis-ready derivatives, canonical evidence records, uncertainty/dependence contracts, benchmark scenarios and stacks, feasibility/evidence-support results, and explicitly synthetic/model-derived sensitivity artifacts. Raw upstream archives are not mirrored.
